mapper.insert: insert into review_tb(review_id, room_id, mentor_id, mentee_id, review_title, review_content, review_code_path, review_language, review_reg_date) values(#{reviewId}, #{roomId}, #{mentorId}, #{menteeId}, #{reviewTitle}, #{reviewContent}, #{reviewCodePath}, #{reviewLanguage}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s'))
mapper.select: select review_id as reviewId, room_id as roomId, mentor_id as mentorId, mentee_id as menteeId, review_title as reviewTitle, review_content as reviewContent, review_code_path as reviewCodePath, review_language as reviewLanguage, review_reg_date as reviewRegDate from review_tb where review_id=#{reviewId}
mapper.update: update review_tb set review_code_path=#{reviewCodePath} where review_id=#{reviewId}
